summary_en: ¥145/share annual dividend for FY3/27 (¥10 increase from ¥135): mid-term ¥70 (+¥5), year-end ¥75 (+¥5). DOE 4.1%. Reflects upward FY3/27 earnings revision (operating profit ¥26.5B, +47.2%; net income ¥13.5B, +35.0%). Company targets DOE 4%+ and stable progressive increases per medium-term plan.
title_en: Notice of Upward Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast for FY3/27 and Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Restar Corporation announced on 6 August 2026 an upward revision of its full-year consolidated earnings forecast for FY3/27 (ending 31 March 2027) and a corresponding dividend increase. The company raised FY3/27 operating profit from ¥18.0B to ¥26.5B (+47.2%), net income from ¥10.0B to ¥13.5B (+35.0%), and sales from ¥700B to ¥750B (+7.1%), citing strong Q1 demand in data-centre equipment and semiconductor manufacturing tools, plus contributions from automotive projects launched in the prior year.

The dividend was increased by ¥10/share to ¥145/share total: mid-term dividend raised ¥5 to ¥70/share, year-end dividend raised ¥5 to ¥75/share. The revision aligns with the company's medium-term plan targets of DOE 4%+ and stable, continuous dividend growth. The revised payout generates a DOE of 4.1%.
